name: Hair Straightener
description: Guidelines for traveling with hair straightener in your luggage.

carryOn.reason: Electric flat irons and straighteners are allowed in carry-on. Cordless/butane hair straighteners must travel in carry-on with safety covers.

checkedBag.reason: Butane-powered straighteners are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Electric straighteners are allowed in checked bags.

tsa.pageTitle: Can I bring hair straightener on a plane?

travelTips: Electric flat irons and straighteners are allowed in carry-on. Cordless/butane hair straighteners must travel in carry-on with safety covers.

faq.question: Is hair straightener allowed in carry-on bags?
faq.answer: Hair Straightener is allowed in carry-on luggage. Electric flat irons and straighteners are allowed in carry-on. Cordless/butane hair straighteners must travel in carry-on with safety covers.

faq.question: Can you pack hair straightener in checked baggage?
faq.answer: No, Hair Straightener is not allowed in checked bags. Butane-powered straighteners are prohibited in checked baggage holds. Electric straighteners are allowed in checked bags.
